x-fahce-payment.workshop_definition: Workshop is FAHCE's authenticated owner workflow interface; payment for a machine determination grants no owner workflow authority.
x-fahce-payment.authentication: Wallet-only x402 purchase: verified gateway PAYMENT-CONTEXT creates a payment-bound machine principal for the exact operation and stored receipt. No prior key, invitation or account is required. Payment grants no human, Workshop, Admin or external execution authority.
x-fahce-payment.retry: Read HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED, use an x402 v2 client to authorize the selected requirement, then repeat the same REST URL, JSON and optional compatible Idempotency-Key (8 to 128 URL-safe characters); origin execution identity is server-owned with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Clients never create PAYMENT-CONTEXT.
x-fahce-payment.origin_validation: Ed25519 JWT from https://payments.cloudflare.com/certs; aud must equal the full canonical operation URL, including /api/v1/{operation}, not just the origin or the Everyone access policy. Timing, scheme and signed amount are required. Alternate hosts and query variants are rejected. A client-supplied header alone grants no authority.

headers.PAYMENT-REQUIRED: Gateway to client: base64 JSON requirements in HTTP 402
headers.PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: Client to gateway: base64 JSON x402 v2 payment authorization
headers.PAYMENT-CONTEXT: Gateway to origin: signed JWT; clients do not generate it
headers.PAYMENT-SETTLEMENT: Origin to gateway only: actual upto amount; omitted for exact and HTTP errors; removed before delivery to buyer
headers.PAYMENT-RESPONSE: Gateway to client: settlement receipt after successful settlement; never fabricated by the origin

x-fahce-payment.settlement: Exact: the origin omits PAYMENT-SETTLEMENT; the gateway settles the signed fixed amount and creates PAYMENT-RESPONSE after settlement. Bundle: zero for a nonbillable free-retry determination; 150000 for verified no-repair work; 390000 only for a required validated bounded repair plan. Held/invalid plans and unsupported processing return HTTP422 without an origin settlement instruction. A valid completed negative Verify returns its contracted determination and is billable even when verification.verified=false. HTTP 422 alone is not proof of no gateway charge; reconcile that individual purchase before paying again. A proposed plan never establishes external execution.
x-fahce-payment.receipts: Immutable origin receipts keep payment_receipt and settled_price_atomic_units null, including after delivery; later observations live in the separate append-only financial ledger. Customers retain the separate gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement receipt. Origin delivery intent is not a charge receipt. The October 14 production purchases completed gateway settlement and seller receipt. Automated ledger reconciliation is a separate accounting workflow; an immutable pending origin receipt does not negate a separately confirmed settlement.
x-fahce-payment.repeated_delivery: One delivery intent per signed authorization. Retain FAHCE-Recovery-Token and read the exact saved receipt with Authorization: FAHCEReceipt <capability>, without payment. Repeated delivery returns a distinct 409 without releasing a recovery token or another result; use the original token, or request verified original-purchase recovery if the first response was lost. Do not authorize another payment to retry an unknown charge.
x-fahce-payment.mcp: Discovery is free. MCP tools/call does not execute commercial operations. Buy through corresponding REST URLs; no pilot key can bypass their rules, whether acceptance is on or off.
external_dependencies: Active gateway rules and valid payment authorization

parameters.name: FAHCE-Terms-Accepted
parameters.description: Current published legal_documents.publication_hash, accepted by the authorized customer or its agent before payment.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client alias; authorization, operation and canonical body hash define server-owned purchase identity. Same key with changed input conflicts. Recovery is free and never requires a new authorization.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 v2 wallet authorization on the unchanged gateway retry when activated. No customer API key or prior account is required.

parameters.name: X-FAHCE-Discovery-Source
parameters.description: Optional acquisition source; never include candidate text or credentials.

200.description: Completed bounded determination and immutable origin receipt. Inspect verification.verified, billing and claim support. Immutable origin charge fields remain null; retain the separate gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE for paid settlement.

FAHCE-Recovery-Token.description: Cryptographically random purchase-specific recovery token; only its protected verifier is stored; use Authorization: FAHCEReceipt <value> on GET /api/v1/receipts/{receipt_id}.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Gateway-generated base64 JSON settlement receipt after settlement. Zero-settlement gateway receipt behavior remains to be verified. The origin never creates it.

401.description: Legacy credentials or a receipt-only read capability are missing or invalid; commercial wallet purchase requires no prior key.

402.description: Gateway payment required: decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED and retry unchanged with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE from an x402 v2 client. This response is generated by the gateway; its body is provider-defined and is not a FAHCE MachineError envelope. Use the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 JSON requirements; upto amount is the authorized maximum.

403.description: Gateway payment context or receipt-only capability is invalid/missing; payment does not grant owner permissions.

409.description: Conflicting key or repeated paid delivery. Read the retained receipt and reconcile an unknown gateway charge before authorizing another payment. Revised input requires a new key.

x-fahce-error-codes.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Key or authorization reused with conflicting input, operation or account
x-fahce-error-codes.PURCHASE_ALREADY_COMPLETED: No second execution; use the scoped recovery route
x-fahce-error-codes.DELIVERY_RECOVERY_IN_PROGRESS: Original execution is reserved; recovery is pending
x-fahce-error-codes.PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_PENDING: Original purchase did not reach completed delivery; reconcile before another payment

x402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402Payment.description: Wallet-only x402 v2 retry after gateway HTTP402. No prior API key or account and no mandatory Idempotency-Key; origin trusts only gateway-signed PAYMENT-CONTEXT.

receiptAccess.name: Authorization
receiptAccess.description: FAHCEReceipt <FAHCE-Recovery-Token>. Receipt-only capability returned by the origin; scoped to the exact receipt UUID, not another purchase or privileged action.

pilotBearer.description: Existing human/owner credential for historical receipt access only. It never authorizes a commercial machine POST.

pilotSession.name: fahce_pilot_session
pilotSession.description: Current authenticated session backed by a repair-scope pilot key. Mutating requests require an Origin header matching this API origin. Payment authorization is separate.

MachineRequest.description: Entire REST request JSON must fit 524288 UTF-8 bytes, including labels and escaping; per-field ceilings cannot all be used together. Character limits use UTF-16 code units. MCP tools/list describes this schema inside a request wrapper for discovery only; paid execution uses REST, not tools/call.

schema.description: Request contract identifier; use this exact value.

candidate_output.description: The exact candidate output to diagnose or verify. Never use payment evidence as semantic evidence.

expected_output.description: Optional format/constraint and repair-target context for all operations, including Diagnose. Recognized directives (e.g. Return JSON) can affect diagnosis. Factual text is not compared for string equality or trusted as evidence; supply independent records.

evidence.description: Caller-supplied records; sources are not authenticated or fetched. An empty array supplies no corroboration.

id.description: Unique evidence identifier within this request.

kind.description: Record format category, not a trust level.

source_label.description: Source attribution; candidate/output labels mark untrusted claims, not independent proof.

text.description: Record content to review; never payment authorization as semantic proof.

claim_bearing.description: True marks candidate claims, not corroboration. False or omission does not override candidate-source labels.

request_id.description: Determination UUID, identical to receipt.case_id and receipt.run_id. Use this UUID as receipt_id in GET /api/v1/receipts/{receipt_id}. Error-envelope request_id is a separate HTTP trace; use its receipt_id when present.

tenant_model.description: Cloudflare wallet-only purchases use PAYMENT_CONTEXT_ISOLATION: one authorization-bound principal, no human account privileges. Legacy key calls use PILOT_USER_ISOLATION.

credential_id.description: Null for wallet-only Cloudflare machine purchases. A credential exists only for legacy key-backed calls; it is never a prerequisite for an ordinary paid buyer.

byte_inspection.description: Source bytes inspected; this does not establish semantic interpretation of every field.

payment_receipt.description: Immutable origin receipt; separate gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE is retained by the buyer.

settled_price_atomic_units.description: Origin has no confirmed gateway settlement amount. Financial confirmation is recorded separately; the original response remains immutable and settlement is never inferred.

maa_token.description: Microsoft-signed MAA JWT; verify against the published trust material and exact response binding.

error.description: Stable error code. A valid completed negative Verify is HTTP200 and billable; verification.verified=false is not a processing failure. Unsupported processing and held/invalid plans are nonbillable and may return HTTP422 with safe metadata only. An HTTP error is not proof of no gateway charge.

receipt_id.description: Reference only; it does not authorize private content access.

acceptance.notice: Review these policies before payment; the authorized customer or its agent accepts this exact published version by sending this header on the purchase request.
